python3 -c 'import base64,io,stat,tarfile
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('"'"'/run/image-build-output'"'"')
names = ['"'"'btrfs-check.txt'"'"', '"'"'btrfs-compression.txt'"'"', '"'"'build-status.txt'"'"', '"'"'image-explicit-packages-actual.txt'"'"', '"'"'image-explicit-packages.txt'"'"', '"'"'image-package-delta.json'"'"', '"'"'image-package-files.txt'"'"', '"'"'image-package-manifest.txt'"'"', '"'"'image-targets.txt'"'"', '"'"'raw-image-size.txt'"'"']
files = []
total = 0
for name in names:
    path = root / name
    if not path.exists():
        continue
    info = path.lstat()
    if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
        raise RuntimeError('"'"'Build diagnostic must be a regular file: '"'"' + name)
    total += info.st_size
    if total > 20971520:
        raise RuntimeError('"'"'Build diagnostics exceed the size limit'"'"')
    files.append((path, name))
data = io.BytesIO()
with tarfile.open(fileobj=data, mode='"'"'w:gz'"'"') as archive:
    for path, name in files:
        archive.add(path, arcname=name, recursive=False)
print(base64.b64encode(data.getvalue()).decode())
'
systemctl poweroff
